gloss: to handle; to manage; to master; to digest

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: こなしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to handle; to manage; to deal with competently
definitions.explanation: To successfully handle or manage tasks or situations.

definitions.gloss: to master; to become proficient at
definitions.explanation: To become skilled at something through practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧こなす。
⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧こなさ⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I have to get through a large amount of paperwork.
She is proficient in three languages.

notes:
こなす means to handle, manage, or master something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧こなす

USAGE:
- Implies competent handling or skilled management
- Often suggests dealing with a large volume or difficulty
- Can imply getting through or completing tasks

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧こなす: handle work
- ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧こなす: get through volume
- ⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧こなす: fulfill a role
- ⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧こなす: handle well
- ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧こなす: handle difficult work

WRITING:
- Usually written in hiragana
- Can be written as {熟|こな}す (rarely used)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧: to process, handle
- ⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deal with
- {使|つか}いこなす: to master using
